item.title: Admin Post - Info - Closed
item.content:encoded:
Locking this thread as another exists for the same concept in progress. Reviewers, please comment here: http://www.scpwiki.com/forum/t-13895869/my-scp-idea

As per the Ideas Critique forum required reading: http://www.scp-wiki.net/forum/t-13282684/required-reading:how-to-use-this-forum-ideas Please do not create multiple threads for the same working concept. Using one thread helps keep spam down, and prevents flooding of the forums with repeat threads. Furthermore, it helps reviewers a lot if all corresponding feedback is kept in one place so they can follow the development of the idea and its details.

If you're having trouble getting further replies on a thread, you can look at this thread for options to contact reviewers: http://www.scp-wiki.net/forum/t-13282692/how-to-get-more-reviews

item.title: Dianas SCP idea
item.content:encoded:
Seeking Greenlights: Yes

Page Type: SCP Article

Elevator Pitch: Humanoid entity's that live and roam dry uninhabited stretches of road
- Eat what ever they can
- High intelligence/cunning
- Hard to kill
- Very strong
- Hunt in pacts

Central Narrative: Upon several civilian disappearances in western US and Mexico, agents where sent to investigate the issue, all but one field agent died in the search and the field agent brought back information of SCP-XXXX.

There are a unknown amount of SCP-XXXX, but several SCP-XXXX settlements have been discovered. There are only ██ SCP-XXXX entity's in foundation custody.

Hook/Attention-Grabber: The entire species of SCP-XXXX can not be contained or eradicated, as long as there is empty road then SCP-XXXX will be there.

Additional Notes: I need some help with the description of SCP-XXXX
